weprospectify.title: B2B Sales Prospecting Platform
weprospectify.subtitle: Full-stack SaaS platform that automates the entire B2B sales prospecting lifecycle.

challenge.intro: Sales teams waste hours every day on manual prospecting — searching for leads, writing personalized outreach, tracking responses across channels, and keeping CRM data in sync. The process is fragmented across multiple tools with no single source of truth.
painPoints: Manual lead research consuming 3+ hours daily per SDR
Generic outreach emails with low response rates
No unified view across email and LinkedIn campaigns
CRM data constantly out of sync with actual pipeline

solution.intro: We built WeProspectify — a multi-channel outreach platform that handles the full prospecting lifecycle from lead discovery to campaign execution. The platform integrates AI-powered personalization with automated campaign management.
solution.approach: Built on Next.js with Supabase for real-time data, n8n workflows handle the automation backbone — lead enrichment, campaign sequencing, and CRM sync. OpenAI generates personalized outreach based on prospect data. Stripe handles subscription billing for the SaaS model.

takeaways: AI personalization significantly improves outreach quality when trained on good prospect data
n8n proved ideal for orchestrating complex multi-step automation sequences
Real-time Supabase sync keeps the entire pipeline visible without manual updates

layovr.title: Airport Passenger Experience App
layovr.subtitle: Travel platform helping passengers make the most of airport layovers with real-time data.

challenge.intro: Travelers with layovers often waste hours at airports with no idea what's available around their gate. Flight information is scattered across different apps, and there's no way to connect with other travelers or discover nearby services.
painPoints: No centralized platform for layover planning
Flight data scattered across multiple apps and screens
No way to discover gate-specific F&B and services
Travelers feel isolated during long layovers

solution.intro: We built Layovr — a platform that combines real-time flight tracking with location-based airport services and a gate community feature. Travelers can look up flights, discover nearby offers, and connect with other passengers in their gate area.
solution.approach: Next.js frontend with Supabase for user data and real-time features. AviationStack API provides live flight data. Location-based services use geofencing to show relevant gate-area offerings. The community feature uses Supabase Realtime for instant messaging.

takeaways: Aviation APIs require robust error handling — flight data can be delayed or inconsistent
Location-based features need careful UX to avoid overwhelming users with options
Supabase Realtime worked excellently for the community chat feature

ai-video-generation.title: AI-Powered Marketing Video Generation
ai-video-generation.subtitle: Automated pipeline generating 50+ marketing videos weekly from single images.

challenge.intro: A marketing agency was spending enormous time creating video content variations from static images. Each video required manual editing, caption generation in multiple languages, and export to various formats for distribution.
painPoints: Manual video creation taking hours per piece
Multi-language captions required manual translation
No scalable way to produce content variations
Distribution data scattered across spreadsheets

solution.intro: We built an end-to-end video generation pipeline using n8n, OpenAI, and Ideogram. The system takes a single image input through an Airtable interface, generates multiple video variations, adds multi-language captions, and exports structured data for distribution.
solution.approach: The n8n workflow orchestrates the full pipeline: image input from Airtable triggers OpenAI for content generation, Ideogram for visual variations, and automated caption generation in multiple languages. Results are exported to Google Sheets for the distribution team.

takeaways: Airtable as a user interface dramatically reduces training time for non-technical team members
AI-generated content quality improved significantly with structured prompting
The pipeline scales linearly — doubling output requires zero additional labor

ai-voice-agent.title: AI Voice Agent for Customer Support
ai-voice-agent.subtitle: 24/7 AI phone agent handling 85% of customer inquiries without human intervention.

challenge.intro: A construction company received constant customer calls about project status, delivery schedules, and basic inquiries. Their small support team couldn't handle the volume, especially outside business hours, leading to missed calls and frustrated customers.
painPoints: Support team overwhelmed with repetitive status inquiries
No after-hours availability for customer calls
Project status information scattered across multiple systems
Missed calls leading to customer dissatisfaction

solution.intro: We built an AI voice agent using 11Labs voice technology connected to the company's project data via n8n workflows. The agent answers calls naturally, accesses real-time project data from Airtable, and logs all interactions automatically for the team to review.
solution.approach: 11Labs provides natural voice synthesis. n8n workflows handle the intelligence layer — routing calls, querying Airtable for project data, and logging interactions. OpenRouter powers the conversational AI that understands context and provides accurate answers.

takeaways: Voice AI quality is now good enough for professional customer-facing applications
Structured project data in Airtable was key — the AI is only as good as its data access
Automatic interaction logging gives the team visibility without manual work

lead-generation-pipeline.title: End-to-End Lead Generation Pipeline
lead-generation-pipeline.subtitle: 14 interconnected workflows creating a single source of truth for all lead data.

challenge.intro: A B2B sales team was managing leads across multiple disconnected platforms — Smartlead, Heyreach, Airtable, and a Supabase database. Data was constantly out of sync, leads fell through the cracks, and response times suffered.
painPoints: Lead data fragmented across 4+ platforms
No single source of truth for pipeline status
Manual data entry causing duplicates and errors
Slow response times due to missed notifications

solution.intro: We designed and built 14 interconnected n8n workflows that orchestrate the entire lead lifecycle across all platforms. A single source of truth database in Supabase handles deduplication, status tracking, and sync across all tools.
solution.approach: Each workflow handles a specific sync scenario — inbound leads from Smartlead, LinkedIn responses from Heyreach, manual additions from Airtable. Edge cases like duplicate detection, status conflicts, and platform-specific data formats are all handled automatically.

takeaways: Process mapping before automation was critical — without understanding all data flows first, the workflows would have missed edge cases
n8n's ability to handle complex branching logic made it ideal for multi-platform orchestration
A single source of truth database eliminates the root cause of data sync issues

automated-invoicing.title: Automated Invoicing System
automated-invoicing.subtitle: Complete invoicing lifecycle automated with 95% error reduction and full audit trail.

challenge.intro: A client with complex invoicing requirements was handling everything manually — creating invoices, tracking edits, managing cancellations, and reissuing corrected versions. The process was error-prone and lacked any audit trail for compliance.
painPoints: Manual invoice creation consuming hours daily
High error rate in invoice amounts and details
No audit trail for compliance requirements
Cancellation and reissue process was confusing and slow

solution.intro: We built an n8n-powered invoicing system with an intuitive Airtable interface. The system handles the complete lifecycle — creating, editing, canceling, and reissuing invoices — with full audit trails at every step.
solution.approach: Airtable serves as the user interface where the team manages invoice data. n8n workflows handle the business logic: validation, PDF generation, status tracking, and audit logging. Every action is timestamped and traceable.

takeaways: Airtable as a front-end dramatically reduces training time compared to custom UI
Full audit trails should be built in from day one, not retrofitted
The one-click interface increased team adoption to near 100%

stripe-refund-automation.title: Automated Refund Processing System
stripe-refund-automation.subtitle: One-click refund system processing 200+ daily refunds with zero manual errors.

challenge.intro: An e-commerce business was processing refunds manually through multiple systems — checking orders in one tool, processing refunds in Stripe, updating accounting in Lexoffice, and tracking everything in spreadsheets. Each refund took 15+ minutes.
painPoints: Each refund required touching 4 separate systems
15+ minutes per refund, 200+ refunds daily
Manual errors causing accounting discrepancies
Team burned out on repetitive administrative work

solution.intro: We built a one-click refund system using Make.com. A simple checkbox in Airtable triggers the entire refund workflow — processing through Stripe, updating Lexoffice, and logging the transaction.
solution.approach: Make.com orchestrates the workflow: checkbox trigger in Airtable → Stripe refund API → Lexoffice accounting update → confirmation notification. Error handling catches failed refunds and alerts the team.

takeaways: The simplest possible UI (a checkbox) drove the highest adoption rate
Connecting accounting software early in the workflow prevents reconciliation issues
Error handling is critical when automating financial transactions

car-supplier-integration.title: Car Supplier Data Integration
car-supplier-integration.subtitle: Unified pipeline syncing 500+ vehicle listings daily from 3 supplier APIs.

challenge.intro: A car reseller needed to aggregate vehicle data from multiple suppliers, each with different API formats and update schedules. Listings had to be enriched with market data and synced to their sales platform in near real-time.
painPoints: 3 supplier APIs with incompatible data formats
Manual data entry causing listing errors
No automated enrichment with market pricing data
Sales platform inventory always out of date

solution.intro: We built a comprehensive Make.com automation that normalizes data from all three supplier APIs, enriches listings with market data, and syncs everything to the Bubble.io sales platform.
solution.approach: Make.com handles the orchestration: scheduled pulls from each supplier API, data normalization into a common format in Airtable, enrichment with third-party market data, and upload to Bubble.io via API. A PostgreSQL database serves as the canonical data store.

takeaways: Data normalization is the hardest part — each supplier has quirks that need handling
A canonical data store prevents sync conflicts when multiple sources update the same listing
Scheduled automation with error alerting is more reliable than real-time triggers for supplier data

invoice-distribution.title: Invoice Generation & Distribution
invoice-distribution.subtitle: Automated invoice generation with smart filing and instant email delivery.

challenge.intro: A company needed invoices generated automatically based on transaction types, filed in the correct Google Drive folders, and emailed to the right recipients — all based on complex business rules that varied by client and transaction type.
painPoints: Manual invoice creation from transaction data
Complex filing rules for different transaction types
Emails sent manually with attachments
Frequent misfiling and missed deliveries

solution.intro: We built a Make.com workflow that handles the full invoice lifecycle: generation from templates, smart filing based on business rules, and automated email delivery with proper attachments.
solution.approach: Make.com pulls transaction data from Airtable, generates invoices via Google Docs API with correct formatting, saves to dynamically determined Google Drive folders, and emails completed invoices to clients. Bubble.io records are updated with delivery status.

takeaways: Business rule complexity is often underestimated — mapping all scenarios before building is essential
Google Drive folder naming conventions matter more than you think for long-term organization
Automated delivery confirmation gives the team confidence the system is working

financial-folders.title: Financial Folder Organization
financial-folders.subtitle: Dynamic folder structures for international accounting with zero manual filing.

challenge.intro: A finance department managing international operations needed dynamic folder structures in Google Drive that match accounting requirements for different jurisdictions. Creating and maintaining these structures manually was time-consuming and error-prone.
painPoints: Manual folder creation for each accounting period
Different structures required per jurisdiction
Invoices frequently filed in wrong locations
No standardization across the organization

solution.intro: We created a Make.com automation that generates folder hierarchies based on accounting rules and jurisdiction requirements, automatically distributing invoices to correct locations.
solution.approach: Make.com workflows create folder structures based on configurable rules — accounting period, jurisdiction, document type. When new invoices arrive, the system determines the correct folder path and files them automatically.

takeaways: Accounting folder structures seem simple but have surprising edge cases across jurisdictions
Automating the organizational layer saves more time than automating individual file operations
Standardized naming conventions should be established before building any automation

volunteer-management.title: Volunteer Management Platform
volunteer-management.subtitle: Internal platform reducing volunteer onboarding time by 80% with role-based access.

challenge.intro: A non-profit volunteering agency needed to manage applicants through a complex multi-step process including background checks, references, and parental approvals. The existing paper-based system couldn't scale and lacked proper access controls.
painPoints: Paper-based application process taking weeks
No role-based access control for sensitive data
Background check workflow entirely manual
No visibility into pipeline status for management

solution.intro: We built a WeWeb application with Xano backend featuring role-based permissions, automated workflow stages, and a dashboard giving management full pipeline visibility.
solution.approach: WeWeb provides the frontend with role-based views — applicants see their status, reviewers see pending applications, admins see the full pipeline. Xano handles authentication, data storage, and business logic. n8n automates notifications and status transitions.

takeaways: WeWeb + Xano is an excellent combination for internal tools that need role-based access
Non-profit organizations have surprisingly complex compliance requirements
Automating status notifications reduced follow-up inquiries by over 60%

q1.question: Does Company Brain read our Slack messages or code?
q1.answer: No. Company Brain only processes metadata — that a message was sent, that a PR was merged, that a document was updated. It never reads message content, code, or document text.

q2.question: Can employees see their own scores?
q2.answer: This is fully configurable. You decide who sees what — individual scores can be visible to managers only, to the employee themselves, or to the whole team.

q3.question: How quickly will we see insights?
q3.answer: First analysis runs within 24-48 hours after connecting your tools. The AI needs a few days of data to establish baseline patterns, but you'll see initial scores immediately.

q4.question: What if we use tools that aren't listed?
q4.answer: We can build custom integrations for additional tools. Company Brain's architecture is designed to ingest activity data from any tool with an API or webhook support.

q5.question: How is this different from Jellyfish or LinearB?
q5.answer: Three key differences: (1) Company Brain is deployed per-company, not SaaS — your data stays isolated. (2) We score across 5 dimensions including Knowledge and Leadership, not just DORA/engineering metrics. (3) Metadata-only architecture means privacy is built into the system, not just a policy.
